content:
Zoe: Quick ask  MicroCo (micro-enterprise) requested an exception for: 30% off first-year pricing + NET60 payment terms (we normally do NET30 for self-serve). They say cash flow is tight but promise to convert to annual at EOY if product metrics look good. Sales is pushing to close this quarter. Need deal-desk + RevManager + CFO sign-off on extended payment term.

Priya: Why 30%? That's large for a tiny ARR. What are the numbers?

Zoe: Short calc: ```
List first-year ARR (if converted): $9,600
30% off first-year = $6,720 (delta = -$2,880)
NET60 means cash delay ~60 days on invoices; credit exposure = ~$6.7k for 60 days
Proposed guardrails: discount only applies to first 12 months, no renewal carryover, 25% non-refundable deposit due at signing, cap total credits at $5k, require CRM note with "micro-strategic-conversion" rationale.
```

Colin: 30% discount triggers RevManager review per policy. Also extended payment terms >45 days need Finance Director/CFO sign-off. If deposit is only 25% that reduces immediate risk but not fully.

Hana: Legal asks to include a clause: if customer churns or downgrades within 120 days, discount is clawed back pro rata or deposit forfeited. Also require standard T&Cs + late fee schedule. I can draft a one-page amendment if Sales uploads SOW.

FinanceBot: Policy check: discounts >=20% require RevManager approval; payment term changes >45 days require Finance Director approval; deals with cash exposure >$5k need AR team review. Attach deal-desk form and short financial model. Internal links: https://intranet.redwood/finance/deal-desk-policy, https://intranet.redwood/finance/terms (internal).

Zoe: AE note: customer is a local gov-funded nonprofit; converting could unlock 3 similar accounts via their integrator partner. Risk is they go to competitor now. Sales proposes pilot conversion clause: if they convert to annual within 6 months, Sales can propose a renewal discount; otherwise renewal reverts to list.

Priya: Finance view: small absolute $ hit but non-trivial cash exposure. Approve conditionally if: 1) 25% deposit collected at signing (non-refundable except legal-approved exception), 2) $5k cap on credits enforced, 3) legal clawback language included, 4) RevManager signs off, and 5) AR confirms collections plan for NET60.

Colin: I can provisionally approve pending the deal-desk form and the deposit evidence. Also want CFO awareness due to policy on extended terms.

Hana: I'll prepare amendment language titled "limited-term conversion concession" and include clawback and non-transferability. Need SOW & customer billing contact.

Zoe: Will upload SOW, customer finance contact, and completed deal-desk form by 2530001200. I'll also add CRM note with tags: micro-conversion + partner-intro.

FinanceBot: Once uploaded, I will auto-route to AR for collection plan and to RevManager for final approval. Mark thread: deal-desk:pending.

Zoe: Thanks all, aiming to have signed SOW + deposit by EOD. :crossed_fingers:
